rules.message: Direct push to main is blocked. Use /branch to create a feature branch, then /pr to open a pull request.
Direct push to master is blocked. Use /branch to create a feature branch, then /pr to open a pull request.
Bare git push without an explicit branch target is blocked. Specify the remote and branch: git push origin <branch-name>
The --admin flag bypasses all branch protection rules. If status checks are pending, wait for them to complete. If checks are failing, fix the underlying issue.
Use --squash flag for PR merges to maintain linear history.
Direct review API calls are blocked. Use ./scripts/hooks/gh-review.sh to submit formal PR reviews.
